# Susanta Banik

> AI/ML Engineer, Full-Stack Developer, Independent AI Researcher. Founder & Principal AI Engineer of Shristi AI Web Creations™, based in Agartala, Tripura, India. "Building Intelligence, thoughtfully."

This file is a concise, human-readable summary for language-model tools. It is not an indexing guarantee. Statuses below are deliberate: experimental and in-development work is not presented as finished or proven.

## Pages
- [Home](https://susanta-banik.vercel.app/): overview, projects, founder section, contact
- [Projects](https://susanta-banik.vercel.app/projects): every project with status and real links
- [Research](https://susanta-banik.vercel.app/research): journal paper and preprint

## Projects
- **LabBench** (Live): A zero-setup, browser-based coding workspace for students, with AI hints that explain errors instead of handing out answers. [demo https://labbench-woad.vercel.app/; repo https://github.com/Susanta2006/labbench]
- **BloodSignal** (Hackathon project): An evidence-aware blood-bank finder built for a hackathon by Team Pragmatrix. It shows what is known, what is stale and what still needs a phone call. Caution: An information tool only. Availability is not guaranteed or real-time, so always confirm with the facility. It is not medical advice. [demo https://bloodsignal.vercel.app/; repo https://github.com/Susanta2006/BloodSignal]
- **CodeWithFun Dev Hub** (Live): An online bookstore for developers and students, with technical books and study material at affordable prices. [demo https://codewithfun-devhub.vercel.app/]
- **Fraud Detection** (Portfolio project): A TensorFlow/Keras deep neural network that classifies transactions as normal or fraudulent. [repo https://github.com/Susanta2006/Fraud-Detection]
- **Emotion Detect** (Portfolio project): A computer-vision tool that estimates a face's emotion using OpenCV, DeepFace and TensorFlow. Caution: Outputs are model estimates, not facts about a person. [repo https://github.com/Susanta2006/emotion-detect]
- **Jarvis-v9** (Ongoing research): Independent research on a modular conversational agent with persistent memory, published as a journal case study and a preprint. [paper https://www.ijsr.net/getabstract.php?paperid=MR251206000138]
- **QNME-omega** (Ongoing research): Ongoing research into memory- and compute-conscious AI/ML workflows for resource-constrained hardware. Caution: Research in progress. No published benchmarks yet. [Repository not yet published]
- **CampusCopilot** (In development): An AI-powered study platform for higher-education and competitive-exam students, in active development. [Repository not yet published]
- **Medical AI System** (Experimental): An experimental decision-support project exploring symptom-based models and how to communicate their uncertainty. Caution: Not a clinically validated diagnostic tool. It must not be used to diagnose or treat any condition.
- **AI Tutor — Document Q&A** (Portfolio project): A retrieval-augmented generation app for asking questions about your own documents.
- **Boreal Basin** (Client product): Client product — details available on request.
- **FSMN** (Ongoing research): An experimental neural architecture based on spiking-neuron dynamics and local learning.

## Research
- Journal paper: "Emergent Social Consciousness in a Minimalist Conversational Agent: A Case Study on Jarvis — Observations from a Custom-Built Artificial Intelligence System", International Journal of Science and Research (IJSR), Vol. 14, Issue 12, December 2025, pp. 480–482. Paper ID: MR251206000138. https://dx.doi.org/10.21275/MR251206000138
- Preprint: "Jarvis-v9: A Continual-Learning Synthetic AGI with Biologically-Inspired Generative Architecture, Persistent Memory, and Nine Cognitive Engines", ResearchGate, 2026. DOI: 10.13140/RG.2.2.12547.05921. https://doi.org/10.13140/RG.2.2.12547.05921
